main_text.head: CAPUT XIII. De Justificatione & Conversione Hominis Peccatoris ex Operibus propriis, aliisq; mediis.
I.
main_text.p: Sic repudiata rupe salutis unica, susque deque Messiæ habita redemptione spirituali, necesse fuit alios animarum quærere duces, aliosque Justificationis suæ apud Deum excogitare modos, quare toti hactenus in eo fuerunt, hocque onus, hicq; labor Judæis unicus fuit, ut per opera sua, Legisve Mosaicæ observantiam, tum à perpetratis absolverentur peccatis, Deoque reconciliarentur, tum perfectam seculi futuri adipiscerentur beatitudinem, & hinc inani externorum privilegiorum opinione, ceremoniarumque nocivaInfatuati pompa, suam Conversionem, Justificationemq; coram Deo benedicto, non doloribus
main_text.notes: Catchword absent. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page; the line "ceremoniarumque nocivainfatuati" is printed as shown with the words run together, and "Justificationemq;" is read as printed. The word "nocivainfatuati" may be a printer's run-together of "nociva infatuati" (doubtful). The first word "Sic" carries a large woodcut-style initial S, transcribed as "Sic".
